⚡ Quick scan: one tap, a ready PDF.

📐 Frame: fit the sheet into the A4 frame on the screen.
🎯 Auto: the camera finds the edges of the sheet itself and straightens it.
⚠️ Auto: if the sheet goes past the view or cannot be seen, the app warns you: move the phone away.
📷 The size of the photo follows the PDF quality chosen in Settings (150 / 300 / 600 dpi or Auto). In the dark the flash goes off by itself, and the shot waits until the phone is still.
💾 You choose the file name; the PDF is saved in the background.

%1$s

📷 Scan: Frame or Auto, then Shoot. The item is put on an A4 sheet at real size.

🎯 Auto: no size to pick. The camera finds the item itself and, when it is seen whole and the phone is still, shoots by itself. The page is put on the A4 sheet, its shape kept.
📐 Frame: pick the size under the switch and fit the item into the frame.
💳 Card: licence, residence permit, ID, bank card; both sides go on one sheet.
🧾 Receipt: a long strip can be continued with the next part.
⚠️ In Auto mode the app warns you when the item goes past the view or cannot be seen.
💾 You choose the file name; the PDF is saved in the background.
